source.primary_witnesses: Aramaic DSS fragments (4Q201-4Q207; late 3rd c. BCE through 1st c. BCE) where preserved; Greek Akhmim Panopolitanus (6th c. CE) where Aramaic absent; Ge'ez (medieval; the only complete witness) as fallback
source.transliteration_convention: Scholarly conventions: Aramaic Imperial-Aramaic transliteration per Milik 1976 (ḥ ṣ ʿ ḫ); Greek SBL convention (η→ē, ω→ō, θ→th, etc., matching Matthew precedent); Ge'ez SBL Ge'ez convention (ḫ ḫ̣ ʾ ʿ ä for ä-vowel)
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against Milik 1976 DJD apparatus + Nickelsburg 2001 Hermeneia + original codicology
source.fetchedFrom: Milik 1976 The Books of Enoch + Black 1985 Greek text + Charles 1912 Ge'ez PD + Knibb 1978 Ge'ez critical edition + Nickelsburg 2001 Hermeneia commentary
source.citation: Milik 1976 The Books of Enoch (Oxford); Black 1985 The Book of Enoch or 1 Enoch (SVTP 7, Leiden); Nickelsburg 2001 1 Enoch 1 Hermeneia; Charles 1912 The Book of Enoch (Oxford, PD); Knibb 1978 The Ethiopic Book of Enoch (Oxford); Tigchelaar-García Martínez 2000 DJD XXXVI; VanderKam 1984 Enoch and the Growth of an Apocalyptic Tradition.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 26 — JERUSALEM AS CENTER OF THE EARTH — Aramaic 4Q204 1 xi partial; Greek Akhmim 26:1-6 substantially complete; Ge'ez full. The 'blessed center of the earth' = Jerusalem/Mt Zion. Sets up Gehenna in ch 27.

verses.text_greek: Καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ἀπῆλθον εἰς μέσον τῆς γῆς, καὶ εἶδον τόπον εὐλογημένον, δένδρα ἔχοντα παραφυάδας μενούσας καὶ θαλλούσας.
verses.translit: Kai ekeithen apēlthon eis meson tēs gēs, kai eidon topon eulogēmenon, dendra echonta paraphyadas menousas kai thallousas.
verses.text_geez: ወእምህየ፡ ሖርኩ፡ ውስተ፡ ማእከለ፡ ምድር፡ ወርእኩ፡ መካነ፡ ቡሩከ፡ ዘቦቱ፡ ዕፀው፡ ዘቦሙ፡ አዕናድ፡ ዘይነብር፡ ወይሠርጹ፡
verses.notes: **THE CENTER OF THE EARTH (meson tēs gēs).** Cross-corpus: Ezek 5:5 ('this is Jerusalem; I have set her in the midst of the nations'); Ezek 38:12 ('the navel of the earth'); Jub 8:19 (Mt Zion as 'the navel of the earth, the center of the world'). The Jerusalem-as-omphalos motif is foundational temple-cosmology.

verses.text_greek: Καὶ ἐκεῖ εἶδον ὄρος ἅγιον, καὶ ὑποκάτω τοῦ ὄρους ὕδωρ ἀπ' ἀνατολῶν, καὶ ἔρρει τὴν ῥύσιν πρὸς νότον.
verses.translit: Kai ekei eidon oros hagion, kai hypokatō tou orous hydōr ap' anatolōn, kai errei tēn rhysin pros noton.
verses.text_geez: ወህየ፡ ርእኩ፡ ደብረ፡ ቅዱሰ፡ ወመትሕተ፡ ደብር፡ ማይ፡ እምጽባሕ፡ ወይውኅዝ፡ ሠረረቱ፡ መንገለ፡ አዜብ፡
verses.notes: **The holy mountain (Mt Zion) with eastern water flowing southward.** Cross-corpus: Ezek 47:1-12 (water flowing from the temple); Zech 14:8 ('living waters shall go out from Jerusalem'); Rev 22:1 (the river of the water of life).

verses.text_greek: Καὶ εἶδον πρὸς ἀνατολὰς ἄλλο ὄρος ὅμοιον, καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον αὐτῶν φάραγγα βαθεῖαν, οὐ πλατεῖαν.
verses.translit: Kai eidon pros anatolas allo oros homoion, kai ana meson autōn pharanga batheian, ou plateian.
verses.text_geez: ወርእኩ፡ መንገለ፡ ጽባሕ፡ ካልአ፡ ደብረ፡ ዘይማስል፡ ወማእከሎሙ፡ ቈላተ፡ ዕሙቅተ፡ ኢሰፋሕ፡
verses.notes: Eastward, another similar mountain (Mt of Olives), with a deep narrow valley between (Kidron Valley).

verses.text_greek: Καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ὕδωρ ἔρρει ἐπὶ τὸ ὄρος τὸ δυτικὸν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ταπεινότερον αὐτοῦ· καὶ ἐν αὐτοῖς φάραγξ ἀνὰ μέσον αὐτῶν βαθεῖα καὶ ξηρά.
verses.translit: Kai ekeithen hydōr errei epi to oros to dytikon autou, kai tapeinoteron autou; kai en autois pharanx ana meson autōn batheia kai xēra.
verses.text_geez: ወእምህየ፡ ማይ፡ ይውኅዝ፡ ላዕለ፡ ደብር፡ ዘዐረቡ፡ ወይትሐት፡ እምኔሁ፡ ወማእከሎሙ፡ ቈላተ፡ ዕሙቅት፡ ወይብስት፡
verses.notes: Westward another lower mountain (the Western Hill); between is a deep, dry valley (Tyropoeon Valley or Hinnom Valley structure).

verses.text_greek: Καὶ ἄλλη φάραγξ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν τριῶν ὀρέων, καὶ φάραγγες βαθεῖαι καὶ ξηραὶ ἐκ τῶν τριῶν· καὶ πᾶσαι φάραγγες βαθεῖαι ἐκ λίθων στερεῶν.
verses.translit: Kai allē pharanx ana meson tōn triōn oreōn, kai pharanges batheiai kai xērai ek tōn triōn; kai pasai pharanges batheiai ek lithōn stereōn.
verses.text_geez: ወካልእ፡ ቈላት፡ ማእከለ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ አድባር፡ ወቈላት፡ ዕሙቃት፡ ወይብሳት፡ እምነ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ ወኵሎን፡ ቈላት፡ ዕሙቃት፡ እምአእባን፡ ጽኑዓት፡
verses.notes: Three mountains with valleys between — the topography of the Jerusalem hills. Sets up the accursed valley of ch 27.

verses.text_greek: Καὶ δένδρα ἐπ' αὐτοῖς πεφυτευμένα. Καὶ ἐθαύμαζον ἐπὶ τοῖς ὄρεσιν καὶ ἐπὶ τῇ φάραγγι λίαν.
verses.translit: Kai dendra ep' autois pephyteumena. Kai ethaumazon epi tois oresin kai epi tē pharangi lian.
verses.text_geez: ወዕፀው፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ተተክሉ፡ ወአደነቅኩ፡ ዲበ፡ አድባር፡ ወዲበ፡ ቈላት፡ ጥቀ፡
verses.notes: Trees on the mountains. Enoch's wonder — preface to the Gehenna question.
